query:
select (select count(*) from pos_web_credenciales) registrados,
 (select count(*) from pos_saldo_mov where motivo in ('recarga','bono_recarga')) recargas,
 (select count(*) from pos_saldo_mov where motivo in ('regalo','bono_instalacion')) regalos,
 (select count(*) from pos_recargas_solicitudes where estado not in ('aplicada','descartada')) por_revisar
